display_title: A warrior from the corner of his room

titles_en.title: A warrior from the corner of his room

description:
Only in the corner of the room! The hidden power of the outcast Yeopo awakens! 

Yeopo, a high school student who is active on the Internet as 'Red Toad 18'. A notorious keyboard warrior, he makes a mistake when writing down the school he goes to while having a keyboard battle with a user called 'Super Bear'. Super Bear, who sees Yeopo's past posts impersonating the student council president, the object of his admiration, and thinks that Red Toad 18 is the student council president, visits the school to punish Yeopo. Although he somehow overcomes the crisis, one of the bullies finds out that he is Red Toad 18, and Yeopo, who has been caught with his weakness, is reduced to a bread shuttle and is forced to give up his empty house as a drinking party venue for the bullies. However, Yeopo has a strange superpower that only works near his house...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
